records.question: Who were the kings of Judah when the word of Yahweh came to Micah?
records.answer: Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah when the word of Yahweh came to Micah.

records.question: From where will the Lord Yahweh testify against the peoples?
records.answer: The Lord Yahweh will testify against the peoples from the holy place where he rules in heaven.

records.question: On what will Yahweh come down and tread?
records.answer: Yahweh will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.

records.question: What will happen to the mountains and valleys when Yahweh comes down?
records.answer: The mountains will melt under him, and the valleys will split open.

records.question: Why will Yahweh bring this judgment?
records.answer: Yahweh will bring this judgment because the people of Israel, the descendants of Jacob, have sinned against him.

records.question: What will Yahweh do to Samaria?
records.answer: Yahweh will make Samaria a heap of rubble with no stones or foundations left standing, only empty fields.

records.question: How did Samaria get her carved images and idols?
records.answer: Samaria got her carved images and idols using money paid at the idol temples to prostitutes who served there.

records.question: How did Micah express his mourning over the sin and coming judgement of Israel and Jacob?
records.answer: Micah wept and wailed, and went barefoot and naked to show his deep mourning.

records.question: Where has this disaster reached?
records.answer: It has reached the city of Jerusalem, the city of Yahweh’s people.

records.question: What should the people do in Beth Leaphrah?
records.answer: They should roll themselves in the dust to show mourning.

records.question: What will the mourning of Beth Ezel show?
records.answer: Beth Ezel will no longer be able to help them stand against their enemies.

records.question: What has Yahweh allowed to happen instead of the good things that the people of Maroth were waiting for?
records.answer: Yahweh allowed terrible things to happen all the way to Jerusalem.

records.question: What city led the people of Zion to sin?
records.answer: The city of Lachish led Zion into sin because they caused them to rebel against Yahweh.

records.question: What will the town of Achzib become to the kings of Israel?
records.answer: Achzib will become a deception to the kings of Israel.

records.question: Who will Yahweh bring to the people of Mareshah?
records.answer: Yahweh will bring a conqueror to take over the town of Mareshah.

records.question: Why should the Israelites shave their heads?
records.answer: They should shave their heads to show that they are mourning for their children who will go into exile.

records.question: Who is this warning being given to?
records.answer: The warning is being given to those who are lying awake in their beds planning to do evil.

records.question: What do these wicked people do to fields and houses that belong to other people?
records.answer: They forcefully take fields, steal houses that belong to other people, and cheat people of their inheritance.

records.question: What does Yahweh say his judgment will be?
records.answer: Yahweh says he is planning disaster against them, and they will not be able to escape it.

records.question: Why will the people say that Yahweh has taken their portion from them?
records.answer: They people will say Yahweh has given the land they inherited to their enemies.

records.question: What will happen in the future when the people of Yahweh assemble to divide up the land by lots?
records.answer: Those receiving this judgment will not receive any part of it.

records.question: What do the false prophets tell the true prophet not to do?
records.answer: They tell him not to prophesy about these things.

records.question: Who do the words of Yahweh spoken through Micah help?
records.answer: His words help those who walk uprightly and do what is right.

records.question: From whom do Yahweh’s people strip the robe?
records.answer: They strip the robes from those who feel safe because they are among their own people.

records.question: What do the wicked leaders do to the women of Yahweh’s people?
records.answer: They force the women out of the homes that they love.

records.question: Why should Yahweh’s people get up and leave?
records.answer: They should get up and leave for this was not a place where they could safely live since Yahweh will destroy it because of their sins.

records.question: What kind of prophet would the people accept?
records.answer: They would accept a lying prophet who promises them wine and beer.

records.question: Who will gather the remnant of Israel?
records.answer: Yahweh will gather the remnant of Israel.

records.question: Who will lead the people out through the gate?
records.answer: Their king will go in front of them, and Yahweh will be leading them.

records.question: What does Micah say the leaders of Israel should know?
records.answer: Micah says they should know how to treat people fairly.

records.question: What do the leaders love, and what do they hate?
records.answer: The leaders love what is evil and hate what is good.

records.question: Who does Micah accuse of acting like butchers?
records.answer: He accuses the leaders of oppressing the people as if they butchered and ate them.

records.question: Why will Yahweh refuse to help the leaders when they cry out to him?
records.answer: Yahweh will not help the leaders because they have done evil deeds.

records.question: What do the prophets promise to people who feed them?
records.answer: The prophets promise peace to people who feed them.

records.question: Why will the prophets no longer be able to see visions?
records.answer: Yahweh will no longer show them anything.

records.question: What will the seers and diviners do because God does not answer them?
records.answer: They will be in mourning and be ashamed and disgraced.

records.question: What does Micah do because Yahweh’s Spirit empowers him?
records.answer: Micah declares to the people of Israel how they have rebelled and sinned against God.

records.question: What do the leaders hate?
records.answer: The leaders hate it when people do what is right.

records.question: How do the leaders build up Jerusalem?
records.answer: The leaders build up Jerusalem through bloodshed and injustice.

records.question: What do the leaders expect before giving a favorable judgment?
records.answer: The leaders will only judge favorably for those who give them bribes.

records.question: What will happen to Jerusalem and the temple hill?
records.answer: Jerusalem will be leveled and become a pile of rubble, and the temple hill will become an overgrown forest.

records.question: What will happen in the last days?
records.answer: In the last days, the mountain where Yahweh’s temple stands will become more important than all the other mountains.

records.question: Why will many nations want to go to the mountain of Yahweh?
records.answer: Many nations will want to go to the mountain of Yahweh to learn about how he wants them to live.

records.question: What will the nations make from their swords and spears?
records.answer: The nations will make farming tools from their weapons of war.

records.question: Where will each person sit after Yahweh brings peace?
records.answer: Each person will sit under his own vine and under his own fig tree, and no one will make them afraid.

records.question: Who the other people groups obey?
records.answer: The other people groups obey their own false gods.

records.question: Whom will Yahweh gather?
records.answer: Yahweh will gather all those whom he had caused to suffer.

records.question: Where will Yahweh reign over his people forever?
records.answer: Yahweh will reign over them forever on Mount Zion.

records.question: What will come back to Jerusalem?
records.answer: The former authority will come back and the kingdom will once again be centered in Jerusalem.

records.question: To what does the prophet compare the pain Jerusalem is experiencing?
records.answer: They are experiencing pain like a woman giving birth.

records.question: Where will the people of Jerusalem be rescued?
records.answer: The people of Jerusalem will be rescued in Babylon.

records.question: What do the nations gathered against Zion say they want to do?
records.answer: They say they want to destroy the city and see the ruins of Zion.

records.question: Who does not know Yahweh’s thoughts?
records.answer: The nations do not know Yahweh’s thoughts.

records.question: To whom will the people of Jerusalem devote the wealth of many peoples?
records.answer: They will devote the wealth of many peoples to Yahweh.

records.question: With has the enemy done to Jerusalem?
records.answer: The enemy has surrounded the city and laid siege to it.

records.question: From where will one come to be a ruler in Israel?
records.answer: One who will be a ruler in Israel will come from Bethlehem Ephrathah.

records.question: For how long will God allow the people of Israel to be conquered by their enemies?
records.answer: God will allow their enemies to conquer them until the time when the woman gives birth to her child.

records.question: Who will shepherd his flock in the strength of Yahweh?
records.answer: The ruler will shepherd his flock in the strength of Yahweh.

records.question: What will Assyria do when they come into the land?
records.answer: Assyria will attack and break through their fortresses.

records.question: Who will rescue the people from Assyria?
records.answer: The promised ruler will rescue them from Assyria when they invade the land.

records.question: How is the remnant of Israel like the dew on the grass?
records.answer: Just like Yahweh sends the dew and the rain to make things grow, so the remnant is completely dependent on Yahweh to make them a blessing to other peoples.

records.question: What is the remnant of Jacob compared to among the nations?
records.answer: The remnant of Jacob is compared to a lion attacking a flock of sheep.

records.question: What will happen when the hand of Yahweh rises against his enemies?
records.answer: Yahweh will destroy all of his enemies by the power of his hand.

records.question: What did Yahweh say he would do to the horses and chariots?
records.answer: Yahweh said he would destroy the horses and the chariots.

records.question: What did Yahweh say he would do to the cities and fortifications?
records.answer: Yahweh said he would destroy the cities and tear down all the fortifications.

records.question: What did Yahweh say he would do about sorceries and soothsayers?
records.answer: Yahweh said he would stop their witchcraft and fortune telling.

records.question: What did Yahweh say he would do to the idols and stone pillars?
records.answer: Yahweh said he would take away the idols and stone pillars, and the people would no longer worship what they made with their own hands.

records.question: What did Yahweh say he would do to the Asherah poles and the cities?
records.answer: Yahweh said he would remove the Asherah poles and destroy the cities.

records.question: Whom will Yahweh punish?
records.answer: Yahweh will punish the people of the nations that have not listened and obeyed him.

records.question: What does Yahweh say to do before the mountains and hills?
records.answer: Yahweh says to stand up and present his case, with the mountains and hills as witnesses.

records.question: What will Yahweh do against Israel?
records.answer: Yahweh will bring charges against Israel.

records.question: What did Yahweh invite his people to do if they have anything against him?
records.answer: He tells them that if they have any cause to complain, they can testify against him.

records.question: Who did Yahweh send to lead his people out of Egypt?
records.answer: Yahweh sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to lead his people.

records.question: What does Yahweh want his people to remember?
records.answer: Yahweh wants his people to remember how God miraculously helped them in the past.

records.question: What does the speaker ask about coming before Yahweh?
records.answer: He asks whether he should come before Yahweh with burnt offerings or sacrifice year-old calves.

records.question: What does the speaker ask if he should give for his sin?
records.answer: He asks whether he should sacrifice his firstborn child for his sin.

records.question: What did Yahweh require from his people?
records.answer: Yahweh required his people to act justly, love being faithful to others, and walk humbly with their God.

records.question: Who is Yahweh calling out his message to?
records.answer: Yahweh is calling out his message to the people of the city of Jerusalem, the whole tribe of Israel, and the leaders he has appointed.

records.question: What has Yahweh cursed?
records.answer: Yahweh has cursed the dishonest measures that wicked people use to cheat others.

records.question: Who is not innocent, according to Yahweh?
records.answer: No one who uses dishonest scales or a bag of deceptive weights is innocent.

records.question: Who are those who are speaking lies?
records.answer: The people who live in Jerusalem tell lies.

records.question: Why will Yahweh ruin the city?
records.answer: Yahweh will ruin the city because of the sins of the people.

records.question: What will happen when the people eat, according to Yahweh?
records.answer: They will eat but not be satisfied, because it will not stay inside them.

records.question: What will the people plant and press but not enjoy?
records.answer: They will plant crops but not harvest them, press olives but not use the oil, and crush grapes but not drink the wine.

records.question: Whose laws did the people of city follow?
records.answer: They followed the wicked laws and practices that their previous evil kings, Omri and Ahab, had established.

records.question: What does Micah say he is like?
records.answer: Micah says he is as frustrated as someone who looks for fruit after the harvest but cannot find any cluster of grapes or an early fig to eat.

records.question: Who has perished from the land?
records.answer: All the faithful people have disappeared from the land.

records.question: What do government officials and judges demand?
records.answer: Government officials and judges demand bribes.

records.question: Who foretold the time when God would punish those who do evil?
records.answer: The prophets foretold the time when God would punish those who do evil.

records.question: Whom does Micah say not to trust?
records.answer: Micah says not to trust a neighbor or a friend.

records.question: Who are a man’s enemies?
records.answer: A man’s enemies are the people of his own household.

records.question: Who does Micah say will hear him?
records.answer: Micah says Yahweh, the God of his salvation, will hear him.

records.question: What would happen after the nation is defeated?
records.answer: Even though their enemies will defeat them, they will recover.

records.question: For how long will the people bear Yahweh’s rage?
records.answer: They will bear Yahweh’s rage until Yahweh defends them and makes things right.

records.question: What will Micah watch?
records.answer: Micah will watch as his enemy’s homes are destroyed.

records.question: What will happen when the time comes to build the walls?
records.answer: When the time comes to build the walls, the boundaries will be extended very far.

records.question: What will happen to the land because of the deeds of its people?
records.answer: The land will become an empty wasteland because of the evil deeds of its people.

records.question: How does Micah ask Yahweh to shepherd his people?
records.answer: Micah asks Yahweh to shepherd his people with his rod.

records.question: What will Yahweh do for his people?
records.answer: Yahweh will do amazing things for them.

records.question: What will the nations see and be ashamed of?
records.answer: They will see what Yahweh has done and be ashamed of how powerful they thought they were.

records.question: Who will the nations approach and be afraid of?
records.answer: The nations will approach Yahweh and they will be afraid because of him.

records.question: Why will Yahweh not keep his anger forever?
records.answer: Yahweh will not keep his anger forever, because he loves to faithfully love us.

records.question: What will Yahweh do with all the sins of the people of Israel?
records.answer: Yahweh will forgive all their sins as if he is throwing all their sins into the depths of the sea.

records.question: What will Yahweh show to Jacob and Abraham?
records.answer: Yahweh will show trustworthiness to Jacob and covenant faithfulness to Abraham, as he promised their ancestors long ago.
